I priced it with one change, as you asked: the standard ASKR with the pickup set to EMG 40TWX.

The EQ switches by itself to the Glockenklang 3 band. The standard Fishman Fluence 2 band EQ only works with Fishman Fluence pickups, so the configurator drops it when you choose the EMG. Every change was applied.

Price lines:
- ASKR base: €3200
- Pickups, EMG 40TWX: +€245
- Onboard EQ, Glockenklang 3 band (switched automatically): +€210
- Everything else stays at the standard build: €0

Total: €3655, excluding VAT. Every option has a listed price, so nothing is still to be confirmed separately.

This is an estimate from the configurator's rules, and RavenForge confirms the final price. The EMG 40TWX housing for the ASKR comes with a note to confirm depth, mounting and wiring before the build.

If you'd like another EQ with the EMG, the Onboard EQ category also has the Darkglass Tone Capsule 3 band (+€165) and the LHZ HAZ clone 3 band (+€270). I can price either one. When you're happy, select the options in the configurator and click "Save specification PDF" to send with your enquiry.
